provision.title: Add new agent
provision.subtitle: An enrollment code is generated, and how long it stays valid is shown next to it. Download the installer: it embeds this code, the GRID address and the agent package. On the endpoint, a double-click is all it takes.
provision.step1: Copy the installer to the endpoint (USB key, network share).
provision.step2: Double-click. Windows shows "Unknown publisher": "More info", then "Run anyway", then "Yes" to the administrator prompt.
provision.step3: The endpoint shows up here within two minutes, with its protection state. Nothing to type.
provision.scriptedNote: Scripted deployment (GPO, SCCM): agent/install.ps1, agent documentation.
provision.noInstaller: No installer is published on this GRID (stub, agent package or authority certificate missing). Publish the package (continuous deployment), then try again.
provision.codeInvalid: This code can no longer be used (expired or unknown): generate a new one.
provision.downloadFailed: The installer could not be prepared. Try again; if it persists, see the GRID log.
provision.hint: After the agent enrolls, it will appear here within 60 seconds (next auto-refresh).

suspended.title: Suspended processes
suspended.subtitle: What this endpoint reports as frozen right now. A process the agent has resumed, or that has exited, leaves this list because the agent said so.
suspended.confirmBody: This will let the process run again. If it was encrypting files, it will carry on. Nothing resumes by itself: this is your decision.
suspended.asked: Resume asked; the agent answers on the alert.
suspended.sendFailed: The request could not be sent.
suspended.resumeFailed: A resume was asked and failed: the process is still frozen, and nothing can unfreeze it before this machine restarts.

command.title: Isolate endpoint
command.warningBody: Once command execution is available on the endpoint, isolating "{hostname}" will cut its network access. Today the command is only recorded: the endpoint is not isolated.
command.reasonPlaceholder: E.g.: Suspected compromise — ransomware detected running...
command.ackLabel: I understand this command is recorded, and that the endpoint will only be isolated once its execution is available.
command.notYetExecuted: The command is recorded; its execution on the endpoint is not available yet. The endpoint is not isolated.
